I answered Dagny in the #canyon-team thread: nothing I'm allowed to check backs up her tip, so it should stay unconfirmed.

- **What the record says:** Moss's Sierra cheat sheet is a public file, last updated Sep 28. It calls the Dreyness Brewing Co. (DBCR) rollout "Quartz", not "Osprey". It names Ulrike Lorcroft, Receiving Operations Lead, as the customer-side rollout lead.
- **What I couldn't find:** a keyword search turned up no mention of an "Osprey" rollout or of Linnea Halvorsen in any channel or file Dagny can see.
- **Who can confirm:** Dreyness is a Sierra account owned by Florian Lorthorpe, so I pointed her to him to confirm it or correct the record.

I only used public files and the brain, and didn't read any Sierra channels. No finance figures came up and nothing needed approval.
